generic_domain.justification: Among the given domains, ecology is more specific than 'ecology and environmental science', which encompasses a broader range of topics including both ecological studies and environmental scientific research. However, if we consider the provided options strictly as separate entities without any hierarchical relationship implied by their naming, it might be necessary to re-examine how they relate. In this case, since one is a subset of the other, 'ecology and environmental science' is more comprehensive.
